flatten_order: C; complete field blocks in the following order

fields.name: motion_anchor_ori_b
fields.meaning: R(current_robot_base)^T @ R(current_reference_base); first two matrix columns flattened row-major

fields.name: command_multi_future_lower_body
fields.layout: q[10,12].reshape(120) followed by qdot[10,12].reshape(120); absolute reference angles, no default-pose subtraction
fields.ankles: pitch/roll-named slots hold Achilles theta_top/theta_bottom motor references, not serial virtual ankle angles

fields.name: vr_3point_local_target
fields.meaning: current target site positions relative to reference base_link

fields.name: vr_3point_local_orn_target
fields.meaning: current site orientations relative to reference base_link, WXYZ quaternions; preserve dataset sign convention

three_point_temporal_scope: one current pose per site, no future point trajectory in this encoder input

outputs.name: encoded_tokens
outputs.meaning: FSQ-quantized numerical codes; reshape to [1,2,32]; feed to action decoder

outputs.name: raw_latent
outputs.meaning: MLP output before FSQ; not decoder-ready tokens

requires_robot_proprioception: Not for this encoder; shared action decoder separately needs 900 values

training_observation_corruption.deployment_note: Use clean features; recorded training examples include root6d corruption

note: This encoder requires all 267 features, including planned/reference leg motion and root orientation. It does not infer leg references from three tracked poses alone.
